title: The end · Credits
description: After either ending's Monday, over black: who made the game and who is in it, rolling up between two collages of snapshots of the adventure and the friends' missions laid down one by one; then, alone, the last card: Nuria Mendoza was on holiday the whole time; then the ending's own closing text and «Fi» (Bajar la mano's, then Acabar's); after it the game goes back to the welcome screen. A key hurries the roll and turns each card. The words are a draft.

steps.eval: window.creditsDone = false; void window.gerard.credits.play('bajar').then(() => { window.creditsDone = true; }); undefined

steps.caption: Over black, the roll begins, and the first snapshots are laid down on either side
Halfway: the collage fills both sides, the adventure and the friends' missions in the order the story meets them
The last card: the collage gone, the false lead closed, Nuria Mendoza's holiday photos dropping in round it (local only: public/private/)
The ending's own closing lines, one after another, and «Fi» under them
The credits close (in the story, the welcome screen comes up next, with «Continuar»)
